verdict.rationale: Pipedream shows error details and stack traces for failed workflows, can automatically retry events that error, and lets you re-trigger a workflow manually with a selected event via Send Test Event. The CLI also returns historical events sent to a source. Nothing shows a browsable execution-history log, a manual re-run of a specific failed execution, or resuming from the failing step rather than re-running the whole workflow. Missing for 10: documented execution-history/log inspection UI, manual re-run of a specific past failed execution, resume-from-failing-step semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
